Applications for January and September 2027 postgraduate courses are now open. Apply now for a postgraduate course
The deadline for applying for courses starting in January 2027 is 7 December 2026. Applications received after this date will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
For courses starting in September 2027, the application deadlines are 27 June 2027 for a decision by 16 July, or 30 July 2027 for a decision by 13 August. Final deadlines are 20 August 2027 for international applicants and 27 August 2027 for home applicants.
If you require a CAS, we recommend you apply with plenty of time to ensure a smooth arrival for your course start date. Find out more about CAS applications
